```yaml
name: Performance Regressions
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
jobs:
  performance-regression:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - name: Setup Pants
        uses: pantsbuild/actions/init-pants@v10
        with:
          setup-commit: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          base-branch: ${{ github.base_ref || 'main' }}
          named-caches-hash: ${{ github.run_id }}
          pants-ci-config: pants.ci.toml
      - name: Run Performance Tests
        run: |
          # Run performance tests for keyboard and captions features
          ./pants test src/python/pants/testutil/performance/keyboard_test.py
          ./pants test src/python/pants/testutil/performance/captions_test.py
      - name: Check for Performance Regression
        run: |
          # Analyze performance metrics and detect regressions
          echo "Checking for performance regressions..."
          # Placeholder for actual performance regression detection logic
          # This would typically involve comparing benchmarks against baseline
          echo "Performance check completed"
```
